workflow_runs.display_title: pm-258/t-1623: Add on-demand local gate closure check

head_commit.message:
pm-258/t-1623: Add on-demand local gate closure check

node scripts/check-gate-closure.mjs preflights the locked modules and
embedded Postgres binaries, then runs this checkout's real
lib/e2e-runner.test.ts, lib/end.test.ts and lib/urashima.test.ts as
bounded nested node --test children. It prints one fingerprinted
otohime.gate-closure.v1 JSON result and exits nonzero on any spawn
error, nonzero exit, signal, timeout, missing, skipped or malformed
result, or fingerprint failure. External evidence is always left
inconclusive.

lib/gate-closure.test.ts drives the verdict logic through a fake
child-runner port, the real runner's timeout/process-group kill, the
real CLI, and a temp-copy negative control that removes serial
enforcement from scripts/e2e.mjs.
